questions.question: Boland set a database record (12/13 season, combined T20 + List A) with a value of 372. Which record is it?
options: Lowest Team Total (all out or completed innings)
questions.explanation: It's the record for 'Biggest Win by Runs', held by Boland.

questions.question: Who has achieved the fifty and 5 wickets in a match double more times, Jessica Candler or Susan Benade?
questions.explanation: Jessica Candler: 1 times. Susan Benade: 2 times.

questions.question: This South African is one of only two bowlers in women's international cricket history to have taken two separate hat-tricks, her second coming against Sri Lanka in May 2025. Who is she?
questions.explanation: Tryon joins Australia's Megan Schutt as the only players to take two hat-tricks in women's international cricket.

questions.question: At Polokwane Oval, who holds the record for 'Most Runs' (T20)?
Who holds the record for 'Most Wickets' in the 06/07 season (List A)?
questions.explanation: Ashlyn Kilowan holds it, with a total of 29.

questions.question: At which ground did Badgers record their 'Largest Win by Runs' (T20)?
questions.explanation: It was at Recreation Ground — largest win by runs of 146, against Kei on 2018/11/18.
